# Trellis

> > Trellis is a platform covering corporate sustainability, environmental strategy, and the intersection of business responsibility with climate policy.

The site features analysis and commentary from thought leaders like Brad Allenby, Joel Makower, and William Sarni on topics ranging from CSR reporting and carbon neutrality to supply chain sustainability and environmental ethics. It documents corporate environmental initiatives and explores the evolving relationship between business practices and ecological responsibility.

## Key Topics

- Corporate Social Responsibility
- Sustainability
- Climate Change
- Emissions Reduction
- Corporate Sustainability
- Sustainable Business
- Carbon Neutrality
- Water Strategy
- Environmental Ethics
- Climate Policy
- Precautionary Principle
- Supply Chain Sustainability
- CSR Reporting
- GreenBiz

## Corporate Social Responsibility & Business Strategy

- [Milton Friedman and the social responsibility of business](https://trellis.net/article/milton-friedman-and-social-responsibility-business): Joel Makower examines Milton Friedman's shareholder primacy doctrine impact
- [Mandatory CSR Reporting for Denmark's Largest Companies](https://trellis.net/article/mandatory-csr-reporting-denmarks-largest-companies): Danish Parliament mandates CSR disclosure for 1,100 largest enterprises
- [Legislating Corporate Social Responsibility](https://trellis.net/article/legislating-corporate-social-responsibility): Michael Levine on Congressional CSR legislation and supply chain compliance
- [Executive Compensation and Corporate Social Responsibility](https://trellis.net/article/executive-compensation-and-corporate-social-responsibility): Rick Seireeni on Nau's CSR-aligned executive compensation practices
- [How Does Green Impact Mergers and Acquisitions?](https://trellis.net/article/how-does-green-impact-mergers-and-acquisitions): Deloitte white paper examines sustainability's role in M&A valuations

## Climate Policy & Environmental Strategy

- [Carbon neutrality and water: Do they mix?](https://trellis.net/article/carbon-neutrality-and-water-do-they-mix): William Sarni on integrating water strategy with carbon neutrality goals
- [Margaret Thatcher's climate leadership](https://trellis.net/article/margaret-thatchers-climate-leadership): Michael Mathres on Thatcher's early climate advocacy at UN conferences
- [Dynamic Versus Static 'Sustainability'](https://trellis.net/article/dynamic-versus-static-sustainability): Brad Allenby on sustainable city models and urban planning approaches
- [Privileging the Present](https://trellis.net/article/privileging-present): Brad Allenby critiques precautionary environmentalism and Kyoto protocols

## Corporate Environmental Initiatives

- [Wal-Mart Sets 100% Sustainable Fish Target for North America](https://trellis.net/article/wal-mart-sets-100-sustainable-fish-target-north-america): Wal-Mart commits to 100% MSC-certified wild-caught fish in North America
- [HSBC Goes Carbon Neutral Three Months Early](https://trellis.net/article/hsbc-goes-carbon-neutral-three-months-early): HSBC becomes first major bank to achieve carbon neutrality via offsets
- [AMD Aims for Lower Emissions, Greener Products](https://trellis.net/article/amd-aims-lower-emissions-greener-products): AMD releases Global Climate Protection Plan with Scope 3 emissions reporting
- [Starbucks Wins Gold for Farmer-Friendly C.A.F.E. Initiative](https://trellis.net/article/starbucks-wins-gold-farmer-friendly-cafe-initiative): Starbucks receives World Environment Center award for C.A.F.E. Practices
- [Clorox Aims to Show that 'Green Works'](https://trellis.net/article/clorox-aims-show-green-works): Clorox launches Green Works cleaning products with Sierra Club endorsement
- [Genencor Delivers First BioIsoprene Shipment to Goodyear](https://trellis.net/article/genencor-delivers-first-bioisoprene-shipment-goodyear): Genencor ships bio-based BioIsoprene to Goodyear for sustainable rubber
- [BP, Long Beach Port to Launch Pollution-Reducing Collaboration](https://trellis.net/article/bp-long-beach-port-launch-pollution-reducing-collaboration): BP and Port of Long Beach partner on cold-ironing vessel emissions project

## Sustainable Supply Chains & Agriculture

- [Research Shows Large-Scale Farming Causes Major Amazon Forest Loss](https://trellis.net/article/research-shows-large-scale-farming-causes-major-amazon-forest-loss): U. Maryland study links Mato Grosso cropland conversion to Amazon loss
- [Tesco Predicts Organic Food Bonanza](https://trellis.net/article/tesco-predicts-organic-food-bonanza): Tesco forecasts billion-pound organic food sales in UK market growth

## Optional

- [Johnson & Johnson Recognizes Environmental Excellence Around the World](https://trellis.net/article/johnson-johnson-recognizes-environmental-excellence-around-world): J&J honors 14 facilities achieving Environmental Strategic Vision goals
- [Pinterest emerging as promising platform for green marketers](https://trellis.net/article/pinterest-emerging-promising-platform-green-marketers): David Wigder on Pinterest's visual format for sustainable brand marketing
